svg.text: Opening with a 6 places the token on START (step 0). Every later step is one arrow. Home needs an exact roll.
Start r6c1 · first moves r6c2, r6c3, r6c4, r6c5, r5c6
Last track cells r8c3, r8c2, r8c1, r8c0, r7c0 · home entry r7c0 (step 50)
Home lane r7c1, r7c2, r7c3, r7c4, r7c5 (steps 51–55) · home = centre r7c6 (step 56)
Distance after opening: 50 track moves + 5 lane moves + 1 move into home = 56 dice steps.
Identical for every colour. The cell behind the start is never visited (faded).
